privacy.title: Privacy policy and terms of use
privacy.intro: Promptcha (promptcha.uz) turns plain words into a ready-to-use AI prompt. This page explains what data we collect, why, and the terms under which you use the service.

sections.title: What data is collected
body: When you sign in with Google we receive only your account identifier, email address, name and profile picture URL. We never see your password.

The text you enter, the chosen direction and AI tool, answers to clarifying questions and the generated prompts are kept as history — on our server for signed-in users, only in your browser (localStorage) otherwise.
Technical data: IP address (to count the daily free limit), request time, the AI provider used and token counts.

sections.title: How data is used
body: To run the service: generating prompts, showing your history, counting free limits.
To improve quality: understanding which tools are popular and what they cost. Personal data is never sold or shared with third parties for advertising.
Your text is sent to AI providers (for example Groq, Google Gemini) to produce the prompt. Your name and email are not sent to them.

sections.title: Cookies
body: After signing in, only a session cookie (promptcha_session, 30 days) and theme/language preferences are stored. No advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
body: Your account and history are kept until you ask us to delete them. Email the address below and everything is removed within 7 days.
Data is stored on a server outside Uzbekistan and only the service owner has access.

sections.title: Terms of use
body: The service is provided as is. You are responsible for the prompts you generate and the results you obtain with them.
Using the service for unlawful purposes, to harm others or to overload the system is prohibited and may lead to account restrictions.
The free plan has a daily limit; Pro terms are shown at checkout. Changes to these terms are published on this page.
